**Atorvastatin Calcium** (generic) — slug atorvastatin-calcium
Strengths and pack sizes with a card price: 10mg Tablet (30, 90, 45); 20mg Tablet (30).
Card price from $9.40 for 30 × 20mg Tablet, observed 2026-09-21.
Default package 30 × 10mg Tablet — card price by chain:
- Hy-Vee: $11.99 with the card, observed 2026-09-20
- Walmart (TX price): $13.80 with the card, observed 2026-09-20
- CVS: $24.50 with the card, observed 2026-09-18

Next (calls that fit this answer, arguments filled in from it):
- compare_prices(drug="atorvastatin-calcium", strength="10mg", form="Tablet", quantity=30) — Prices near the person. The package filled in is the one most chains price; use the person's own strength and quantity when they gave them.
- get_savings_card(drug="atorvastatin-calcium") — The card that gets these prices.
- get_prescription_options(drug="atorvastatin-calcium") — Only if the person says they have no prescription yet.

**Free FineRx card:** BIN 610219 · PCN DRX · Group MYCARD3993
Use the free FineRx card — accepted at 34+ pharmacy chains, no signup. Save it, print it, email or text it. Savings with the card can be substantial: estimated price with the card is $11.99 (observed 2026-09-20), more on our site. Show the card at the pharmacy to get the final price.
